note: Montana U.S. Senate race, researched Oct. 25, 2026.

candidates.name: Kurt Alme
candidates.bio: Former U.S. attorney for Montana, twice appointed by President Trump.

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Alme wants the border secured
source.quote: Now what we need to do is secure the border

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Alme backs the president and military on Iran but would never support ground troops in endless wars
source.quote: I will never support sending our sons and daughters boots on the ground

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Alme would cut federal spending to bring down inflation and building costs
source.quote: we've got to rein in Washington spending

source.title: Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Alme would make health care more transparent and competitive
source.quote: making it more transparent, more competitive, and by putting patients first

source.title: Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Alme says the ACA failed and mainly subsidized drug and insurance companies
Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Alme pledges to lock up violent criminals
NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Alme wants the farm bill passed

candidates.name: Seth Bodnar
candidates.bio: Former president of the University of Montana and an Army veteran, running as an independent.

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bodnar says Congress must decide whether to authorize military action in Iran
NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bodnar supports strong borders and enforcing immigration law, opposes the administration's tactics and backs comprehensive reform
source.quote: We need strong borders and we need to enforce our immigration laws

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bodnar backs zoning and building-code reform to unlock housing supply
source.quote: incentivizing the type of zoning and code reform to unlock more supply

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bodnar would limit private equity purchases of single-family homes
NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bodnar supports stronger antitrust enforcement against corporate monopolies in agriculture
source.quote: Our farmers, our ranchers are getting squeezed by these big corporate monopolies

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bodnar opposes the trade war with Canada
Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Bodnar supports a universal coverage option that keeps choice and competition
Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Bodnar would restore the expired ACA subsidies
Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Bodnar would protect Montana's Medicaid expansion
Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Bodnar would have higher earners pay more into Social Security

candidates.name: Alani Bankhead
candidates.bio: Retired Air Force lieutenant colonel and counterintelligence agent.

source.title: Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Bankhead favors universal health care modeled on TRICARE, paid for by ending the Iran war
Daily Montanan debate report, Oct. 12, 2026: Bankhead would remove the Social Security wage cap so all income is taxed
source.quote: tax the wealthy, and it starts by ensuring that they pay

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bankhead opposes the Iran war
source.quote: I do not support the war in Iran

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bankhead supports comprehensive immigration reform and a faster path to citizenship
NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bankhead would give builders tax incentives for affordable homes
source.quote: providing tax incentives to construction companies that create affordable housing

source.title: NBC Montana, Oct. 18, 2026: Bankhead blames tariffs for the drop in Canadian tourism
